description: Every component at the version current on 2026-07-12 19:00 UTC — the date SIFT core was first validated. SIFT pins are those validated then (re-validated 2026-10-15); REMnux/OpenSearch/Windows use the same as-of date for compatibility with that sift-mcp.
notes: ubuntu_ami is Canonical's noble 20260626 build, the one SIFT was validated on in July.

windows_base_ami is Windows_Server-2022-English-Full-Base-2026.07.15, the oldest still available when this checkpoint was baked (AWS had already deregistered the June image current on 2026-07-12). The baked Windows AMI preserves the exact OS from here on.

OpenSearch 3.5.0 comes from opensearch-mcp's docker-compose.yml at the pinned commit; Docker Hub rebuilds tags monthly, so the exact image digest is recorded in /etc/valhuntir/versions/opensearch on the baked AMI.

Validated 2026-10-15 by a clean full-stack deploy (all four hosts): 9/9 gateway backends ok incl. remnux-mcp, opensearch-mcp, wintools-mcp; Windows joined + case share mapped unattended. REMnux at these pins has 12 failed salt states (Malcat Lite, Speakeasy helper checksums changed upstream since July).

2026-10-16: Windows AMI re-baked with the forensic tools wintools-mcp runs (pins.windows_tools, versions as of 2026-07-12); it replaces the earlier tool-less Windows AMI (ami-0c2d3cd87b8c50006, deleted). Zimmerman (net9, all builds dated Apr-May 2026) and Sysinternals (current; Procdump and Sigcheck were re-published 2026-10-15) can't be fetched by version: the AMI is the frozen copy, with SHA256s in C:\ProgramData\valhuntir\versions\windows-tools.txt.

Re-validated 2026-10-16 by a clean full-stack deploy: 9/9 gateway backends ok; wintools-mcp check_windows_tools finds 29/31 catalog tools (not KAPE, DumpIt); EvtxECmd and Hayabusa run via the gateway's run_windows_command; all tools run as SYSTEM without EULA prompts; no Defender detections.
